questions.prompt: Which civilization developed the first known system of writing?
questions.fact: Cuneiform began as accounting marks for grain and livestock. Writing was invented for bookkeeping long before it was used for literature.

questions.prompt: Which blood cells carry oxygen through the body?
questions.fact: A single one carries roughly a billion oxygen molecules, and lasts about four months before being broken down and recycled.

questions.prompt: How many rings appear on the Olympic flag?
questions.fact: The rings represent the inhabited continents, and their six colours were chosen so that every national flag of the time contained at least one.

questions.prompt: Which animated film features a lion cub named Simba?
questions.fact: It was the studio's B project at the time — most of the sought-after animators asked to work on Pocahontas instead.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the city of Timbuktu?
questions.fact: Timbuktu was a centre of learning, with libraries of hundreds of thousands of manuscripts — many still privately held.

questions.prompt: Which author created the fictional county of Yoknapatawpha?
questions.fact: He set most of his major novels in this invented Mississippi county, and mapped it in detail.

questions.prompt: Which mathematician is considered a founder of computer science and cryptanalysis at Bletchley Park?
questions.fact: His work at Bletchley Park is credited with shortening the war, and he defined the theoretical machine underlying all computing.
